**Credits**
This tool runs `FAIRe2ENA <https://github.com/FAIR-eDNA/FAIRe2ENA>`_ (MIT licence) through a small Galaxy driver that adds input checks, collection date conversion and a choice of sample taxon. The FAIRe checklist is described in Takahashi et al. (2025) *Environmental DNA* 7: e70100. The Galaxy tool was written by Oliver Berry (CSIRO), with Claude (Anthropic).
